bbh_stochastic_limit_inversion.statistical_status: Each row is one prior-specific 95-percent observational upper limit expressed in three equivalent units.

step3b_integrated_energy.smbhb_support_model: Full analytic LM24 mass moment; Newtonian circular inspiral to each source-frame Schwarzschild ISCO
step3b_integrated_energy.interpretation: The benchmark and high-side sums add independently calculated scalar channel energies. The SMBHB scalars use full analytic LM24 moments and are not normalized by an emitted broadband spectrum. The high-side cases need not occur together; their sum is not a universal or jointly inferred population bound.
step3b_integrated_energy.additivity: Distinct GW events add in energy. Shared or nested parent stocks are not counted as independent reservoirs.

uncertainty_lm24_only.source: LM24 SMBH mass-density normalization only; all other ceiling inputs are held fixed

conditional_ceiling.scope: Six conditional channel ceilings. The SMBHB term is one equal-mass merger per present-day remnant; its repeated-merger fixed-frequency factor is excluded. The sBBH term uses the realizable chi1=chi2=+0.7 spectrum.

primary_schwarzschild_inspiral.scope: Full analytic LM24 mass moment; Newtonian circular inspiral through each binary's source-frame Schwarzschild ISCO.

kerr_chi0p7_inspiral.scope: Sensitivity only; adopting it as primary would require a declared SMBHB spin domain.

full_imr_nonspinning.scope: Integrated Husa radiated-fraction sensitivity only; no SMBHB full-IMR population spectrum is adopted.

full_imr_chi0p7.scope: Integrated Husa radiated-fraction sensitivity only; no SMBHB full-IMR population spectrum is adopted.

smbhb_emitted_spectrum.scope: Display-only full-census PTA segment. It is not integrated to obtain either scalar SMBHB energy or a composite sum.

wright_giblin_hazboun.scope: Pre-recombination backgrounds only; this is not a bound on the late-time astrophysical composite.
wright_giblin_hazboun.provenance: Equation and inputs verified against arXiv:2409.15572v1; 2026 PRL metadata verified at doi:10.1103/clwq-n2vp.

giblin_thrane.scope: Pointwise rule-of-thumb levels for radiation-era cosmological sources; explicitly not an astrophysical bound and not an integrated-energy limit. No ratio to a retired broadband composite is emitted.

interpretation.aggregation: The integrated-energy accounting emits both the declared benchmark sum and a sum formed from the five theoretical-upper-limit cases plus one equal-mass SMBHB merger per present-day remnant. The sum excludes the repeated-merger fixed-frequency factor. The cases were calculated separately and need not occur together, so the sum is not a physical ceiling.
interpretation.smbhb_interval: CNM-to-fmerge mapping is conditional on the central LM24 full-census shape, mass-ratio distribution, and redshift kernel; no additional primary-mass selection is imposed
interpretation.smbhb_provenance: 2.11e-15 is derived from the full convergent moment of the erratum-corrected analytic LM24 fit normalized to the 1.8e6 Msun/Mpc^3 census, with no additional primary-mass cut; it is consistent with LM24's published 2.0e-15 forward result
interpretation.lvk_history: constant comoving source-frame rate over a 10-Gyr lookback interval, with redshift dilution and shifted support explicit
interpretation.popiii: Liu--Bromm SFRD plus a declared prompt one-percent merger mapping; the ceiling uses the Planck-calibrated mass endpoint with other benchmark inputs fixed
interpretation.population_scope: inclusive total populations; no unresolved/subtraction forecast is computed without a selection model
interpretation.bbh_population_proxy: 21.687 Msun and 0.04708 come from a deterministic GWTC-5-inspired approximation, not posterior propagation
